Office of Graduate Admissions
Your journey to a graduate degree starts with your application. Are you ready to take that first step?
We are glad that you’ve decided to explore the possibilities at the University of Tennessee, Knoxville. As a land-grant institution of the State of Tennessee, classified by the Carnegie Commission as a research university with very high research activity, the educational opportunities at UT are abundant. Combined with a great location for work and recreation, this makes UT an intriguing place to consider pursuing graduate education.
Let us know how we can help you begin pursuing your goal of attending the Graduate School at UT.
Find a Program
With so many graduate programs to choose from, you should be able to find one that suits your goals.
Start Your Application
Getting into a graduate program starts with an application to graduate school.
Check Your Status
Stay on top of the progress of your submitted application.
Are You an International Applicant?
UT welcomes applications for admission from all countries. Our Admissions for International Students page can help you understand the more specific requirements for international applicants.
